text: Catalog-api and checkout-api only exist on developer laptops today. Marcus Oyelaran's first job is planning how code gets from a pull request to a deployable container -- safely, the same way every time.
The plan: lint and test on every pull request, then build a container image tagged with the git SHA, never a mutable tag like latest.
A vulnerability scan runs on that image before anything ships. A critical finding blocks the push to Amazon ECR -- especially important for checkout-api, which calls VoltPay directly.
Only an image that passes every gate gets pushed to ECR, tagged by SHA, ready for deploy.
Next: planning where those images actually run -- namespaces, resources, and a rollout strategy in Kubernetes.
